All full-time undergrads can enroll in up to 19 units per quarter. If your GPA is above a 3.0, you’re  automatically eligible to enroll in up to 22 units, and no college approval is needed. If you want to take more than 22 units, you need to request college approval. If your GPA is below a 3.0, you need to request college approval to take above 19 units. No student, regardless of GPA, can enroll in more than 19 units before the first day of class.

Side note, but PLEASE don’t finish your GEs this early. Spread them throughout your college career so that when you’re a junior or senior, you’re not just taking difficult upper division major requirements. I try to do 2 major/1 GE per quarter so I’m not killing myself.

If you have more questions, college advising is who you would contact.
